title: Seasick Cavern Sub
prompt: nasty droning bass and drum line
description: A hollow FM sine sub-bass drones in the basement octaves while a slow, deep vibrato makes the pitch lurch and wobble like a seasick organism. A slow saw LFO drags a resonant band-pass filter on a long upward journey over 29 cycles, opening the cavern wider and wider before snapping back, all soaked in room reverb and long delay so the tone breathes inside a vast stone chamber.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(13).range(3, 12)).fmh("<1.5 0.5 1 2>/8")
    .penv("<5 -4 9 -6>/4").pattack(0.003).pdecay(sine.slow(11).range(0.05, 0.22))
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(23).range(0.4, 0.95))
    .bpf(saw.slow(29).range(90, 1700)).resonance(15).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2).lpattack(0.006).lpdecay(0.18)
    .attack(0.004).decay(0.22).sustain(0.6).release(0.1)
    .shape(sine.slow(19).range(0.12, 0.42)).coarse("<1 1 2>/16")
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.32, 0.68))
    .sometimesBy(0.1, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.22).delay("0.5:0.5:0.7"))
    .room(0.55).gain(0.88)
)
